payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure that paths were not shared between the training and test sets, including filtering queries and excluding hyponyms from the test and validation sets that appeared in the training set.

claims.text: None of the queries (synsets) are shared between the training and evaluation (validation/test) sets, ensuring distinct paths.
Queries observed during path training were eliminated to ensure all evaluated queries are new to both path-based and non-path models.
Hyponyms from the test and validation sets that appear as hyponyms in the training set were excluded to prevent models from copying.
